message: 聖沙の条件

name: Misa
message: 「A costume dance party, you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, we already did a formal dance at last year's Holy Night Festival, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「So this Christmas Eve, everyone will dance dressed however they like? Not bad」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't gotten official approval yet, but I think it'll be one of the main events. If it goes through, it'll really boost the festive mood, don't you think?」

name: Misa
message: 「Understood. It's a competition, then?」

name: Synn
message: 「Er... you mean a contest for who has the best costume?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's fine too, though first I'm going to poke every single hole I can in your idea, Sakura-kun」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's draft a list of guidelines. If it turns into a cosplay convention, that goes against the original purpose」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, that's a huge help. When it's just me, I always end up leaving too many openings」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, don't thank me... That's the exact reason we never settle who wins」
Misa opened her notebook to jot down notes to flesh out the proposal--
Huh? Her pen isn't moving.

name: Misa
message: 「What kind of outfit... should I wear, I wonder?」

name: Misa
message: 「Borrowing a shrine maiden outfit from Shio... No, those are sacred vestments. I mustn't use them half-jokingly」

name: Synn
message: 「Wouldn't you pass as a costume just as you are, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--?! Just what is that supposed to mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「You could just let your hair down」

name: Misa
message: 「...N-No way...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not? Nobody's used to seeing it, so you'd definitely stand out」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude. Please don't talk about me as if I were some rare beast」

name: Synn
message: 「Your hair is long and pretty, so I'm sure it'd look great down too」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, obviously!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then show me」

name: Misa
message: 「If the day ever comes when I acknowledge you, I'll show you then」

name: Misa
message: 「Though there's a one hundred percent chance that'll never happen」

name: Misa
message: 「Or instead of transparent flattery, try saying something that actually makes me want to let my hair down」

name: Misa
message: 「*Giggle*, that's impossible for you too, Sakura-kun」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to yours truly. Lend me your ear, Master Synn. At times like this, you just gotta whisper like so, see? *Whisper, whisper*...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, uh-huh, I see」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! Asking Paqy-san is totally unfair!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't touch, so let me see...」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Pervert! You lech!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up already」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Take this! And this!」
Misa uses her hair like a whip and strikes at me.
Taking the brunt of her ticklish assault, I give up. It doesn't look like I'll be blessed with the sight of Misa with her hair down anytime soon.
